title: The Cripples
about: A small first-year memory of Mary and me being limited in how much of the fair we could explore.
description: This track remembers Mary and me jokingly being called "the cripples" during a year when neither of us could get around the fairgrounds very easily. While everyone else moved from place to place, much of our experience happened closer to where we were. I remember lending Mary my crutches and simply spending time together while the fair carried on around us. It wasn't a grand adventure, but it became one of those small memories that somehow lasted.
lyrics: We didn't get too far from here.
There was a whole fair out there waiting,
More than either of us would see.
Funny how being stuck in one place
Made its own kind of memory.
The fair kept moving without us,
Past places we would never know.
Said, "Here, these might help you through."
Of all the things I could remember,
I remember sitting there with you.
Are the ones you somehow keep.
Just two cripples at the fair,
Never saw the whole fair together,
And the rest just passed us by.
A little piece of that first year
